qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Industry-leading ~64-65% gross margins and >35% operating margins demonstrate strong pricing power and engineering lock-in for high-precision die attach and hybrid bonding equipment used in chiplet and HBM packaging.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Compounding Stability & Balance Sheet, REJECT). World-class ~65% gross margins and hybrid-bonding leadership for 2.5D/3D chiplets and HBM, but extreme backend packaging capex cyclicality (>37% net income drop from 2021 peak to 2023-2024) and reliance on convertible note issuances to fund aggressive capital distributions violate Gate 6 fortress peace of mind.
qualitative.evidence: Revenue fell from €749.3M (2021) to €578.9M (2023) before recovering slightly to €607.5M (2024). Net income dropped >37% from €282.4M in 2021 to €177.1M in 2023 and €182.0M in 2024, demonstrating severe backend assembly capex cyclicality. While gross margins are elite at ~64-65% and FCF conversion is high (~€189M FCF in 2024), management aggressively leverages capital returns via convertible debt and senior notes (€350M issued in 2024), causing cash to swing from €671.7M down to €413.5M in 2023 following €435.5M in distributions.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
